intro: This quest concludes the Fenris Keep confrontation by delivering a long-lost relic, the Woven Wand, back to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity. Crafted years ago by three apprentice mages as a symbol of fellowship, the wand was hidden away when Thule Ravenclaw chose the Scourge. Returning it closes a bitter chapter in Bethor's past.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Thule once told me that, long ago, he and two colleagues created a magic wand, woven together from the apprentice wands each mage possessed. This wand was a symbol of their friendship, and although Thule came to despise it he could not part with it, nor could he let the others have it. So he stole the wand, and hid it in Fenris Keep.
Here. Take the wand to Bethor Iceshard, one of Thule's friends from years past. I'm sure he will want it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend. Have you defeated Thule Ravenclaw?

clips.title: Completion
paras: ...what is this? Thule had our Woven Wand? I thought it was lost when our friendship sundered and he sided with the Lich King!
He must not have invoked its power, for if he had I would have sensed it. And it is good that he did not use it...
This is a marvelous find. You have my gratitude, friend, and will be rewarded.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
